us: CENTCOM strikes 2 Larak launchers: 'limited, precise action' · Trump: Kharg 'going to be blown to smithereens!' · Bessent: new sanctions weekly, banks first · George Washington CSG on station
effects: Jordan intercepts 8 Iranian missiles · Brent $90.32, +2.5% · Ledger 83 redirected / 3 disabled / 2 boarded · TankerTrackers: 6.7M bpd past blockade line
iran: IRGC missile + drone attack on 2 US bases in Jordan · NIOC: Kharg 'calm and appropriate' · Azizi: 'Retaliation is coming… JUST RUN!' · Khamenei: confront the 'real enemy'
tldr: The month-long lull broke in both directions: US forces struck two IRGC rocket launchers on Larak Island — the first acknowledged American strike inside Iran since late July — after surveillance spotted crews preparing to fire mine-carrying rockets into the freshly demined strait, and Iran answered the same day with ballistic missiles and drones on two US air bases in Jordan, where Jordan intercepted 8 missiles and US officials reported no significant impacts despite IRGC 'heavy damage' claims. Trump escalated rhetorically to Kharg Island ('going to be blown to smithereens!'), oil jumped back above $90, and CENTCOM's blockade ledger ticked to 83 redirected / 3 disabled / 2 boarded — while a third tanker strike in a week, off Khasab, again drew no attribution.

events.title: US strikes two IRGC rocket launchers on Larak Island — first acknowledged strike inside Iran since late July
events.summary: CENTCOM said US forces struck two Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island, an Iranian-held island at the strait's eastern entrance, after IRGC forces were 'observed preparing to launch rockets with sea mines' into the Strait of Hormuz — a plan, per Fox's Trey Yingst, to redeploy mines into the strait days after CENTCOM declared its international lanes demined. CENTCOM called it 'limited, precise action against IRGC minelaying forces posing an imminent threat' and rejected Tehran's 'act of aggression' framing as false: 'Iran created the threat and the U.S. military eliminated it.' Iranian state media reported explosions near the island; the IRGC acknowledged 'the martyrdom and injury of several of our fighters and compatriots' with no precise toll — state media later named the two dead, Hamid Avazzadeh and Ali Fayazi (names single-outlet via Crypto Briefing; AP corroborates the two-fatality count without naming; Tasnim's drone-strike characterization is unconfirmed — US officials describe launchers struck). Newsweek and AP date the last acknowledged US attack to July 29 (Task & Purpose says July 30): the first inside-Iran strike in roughly a month, ending the lull and beginning a new consecutive-strike campaign.

events.title: IRGC retaliates same day: combined ballistic-missile and drone attack on two US air bases in Jordan
events.summary: The IRGC said it struck 'technical and maintenance infrastructure and the locations where enemy fighter jets are stationed' at two US air bases in Jordan — named by Iranian media as King Hussein and Al-Azraq (base names and the ballistic-missile delivery confirmed on the Reuters wire) — in response to 'the US-Israeli enemy's attack on Larak Island,' claiming 'heavy damage' that US officials flatly contradicted: a US source told Fox nearly all incoming missiles were intercepted with no significant impacts. Jordan's Armed Forces confirmed intercepting eight missiles that entered its airspace (Reuters, citing state TV), with local media reporting explosions near Aqaba. Iran's foreign ministry said the bases had been used to launch and support the Larak strike. The IRGC also claimed to have downed a US MQ-9 drone over the strait — unconfirmed by any second source. Timing note: Jordan's announcement is dated Monday local time; Fox and Jordan state TV place the attacks on Sunday UTC.

events.title: Trump turns his threat on Kharg: 'going to be blown to smithereens!'
events.summary: In a late-Sunday Truth Social post (UTC-straddling into Aug 31), Trump threatened Kharg Island — the terminal handling around 90% of Iran's crude exports, roughly 410 miles from Larak — with destruction; outlets differ on the exact wording (CNBC renders 'going to be blown to smithereens!', The Hill 'been blown to smithereens!!!'). National Iranian Oil Company CEO Hamid Bovard answered on social media that conditions on Kharg were 'calm and appropriate' and 'Trump's tweets are laughable' (Reuters). No strike on Kharg occurred; the threat extends the administration's maximum-pressure frame onto Iran's main oil export terminal.

events.title: Brent back above $90 as the flare-up reprices supply risk
events.summary: Brent climbed $2.22 (+2.52%) to $90.32 a barrel and WTI rose 2.41% to $85.41 in Sunday evening trading (Reuters, as of 2202 GMT), extending to +2.7%/$90.49 and +2.8%/$85.76 at Monday's close (CNBC) — back above $90, up ~25% from the war's start (AP). PVM's Tamas Varga: 'supply risk will persist and oil inventories will continue to deplete'; Goldman flagged refining margins at new highs as regional refinery strikes stretch capacity. The move reverses the prior week's −5% drift and lands on the same day Trump threatened Kharg.

events.title: CENTCOM blockade ledger: 83 redirected / 3 disabled / 2 boarded
events.summary: CENTCOM's X post, edited 9:16 PM Aug 30: 'As of Aug. 30, CENTCOM forces have redirected 83 commercial vessels, disabled 3 and boarded 2 to ensure compliance with the blockade' — one redirected vessel added to Friday's 82/3/2, the first accounting since the blockade tally was refreshed Aug 28. Fox carried the post with an image of an MH-60S Sea Hawk landing aboard the destroyer USS Delbert D. Black in the Arabian Sea.

events.title: Bessent pledges weekly sanctions 'starting with the banks' — and the world so far shrugs
events.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told Reuters the US will roll out new Iran sanctions weekly, beginning with banks helping Tehran reach the global financial system: 'You're going to see a lot more of these every week… we're telling the banks it's not okay to have Iranian money and to aid the regime' — with institutions potentially cut off entirely from the dollar system. The pledge landed ahead of the G20 finance meeting in Asheville, NC. Bloomberg's same-day takeaways measured the campaign's first week: countries with Tehran ties 'had so far shrugged off the threat,' China (buyer of ~90% of Iran's oil) answered with a defiant warning rather than retreat, and Iranian bank branches in Dubai — including a Bank Melli branch in Abu Dhabi — remained open for business. No new institution was designated Aug 30.

events.title: Third tanker strike in a week confirmed: unknown projectile hits tanker 12nm north of Khasab
events.summary: UKMTO WARNING 122-26, confirmed Sunday in a delayed report: a tanker transiting inbound was struck by an 'unknown projectile' at 8:53 PM UTC on Saturday Aug 29, 12 nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman — no casualties or environmental impact, investigation underway, and no attribution claimed by anyone. The incident date belongs to the missed Aug 29 reporting window; the week's ledger now reads Ash Shishah (Monday), a Kuwaiti-connected vessel (Wednesday) and Khasab (Saturday), still no names and no Iranian claim or denial on any. UKMTO added that IRGC harassment — drone overflights, targeted surveillance of merchant vessels, occasional radio transmissions — continues, with commercial traffic 'reduced, albeit with a slight increase compared with recent lows.'

events.title: Tehran's escalation ladder: 'Retaliation is coming… JUST RUN!'; Pezeshkian: 'we are not seeking war'
events.summary: Parliament national-security commission chief Ebrahim Azizi (X, 9:02 PM Aug 30): 'Retesting our will, only makes the cost of your humiliating defeats even heavier… Test our will once more, and pay a heavier price. Retaliation is coming — JUST RUN!' IRGC spokesperson Hossein Mohebi called the Larak strike a 'strategic and fatal mistake' by Washington in its economic war, carrying 'militarily and economically' felt consequences. President Pezeshkian (per Fars, Monday-dated — UTC straddle) said Iran would 'not remain silent in the face of assault' while insisting 'we are not seeking war.' Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, in a rare written Islamic Unity Week statement, called on Gulf Arab states to identify and confront the 'real enemy' and unite 'under the flag of Islam.'

events.title: George Washington CSG on station; TankerTrackers counts 6.7M bpd crossing the blockade line
events.summary: The carrier USS George Washington (CVN 73) has arrived in the Arabian Sea near the strait, replacing the USS Abraham Lincoln as CSG-5 flagship, accompanied by the cruiser USS Robert Smalls (CG 62) and destroyer USS Shoup (DDG 86); Rear Adm. Jeff Heames: the teams are 'ready, determined, and resourced for sustained operations.' TankerTrackers reported Sunday that crude exports crossing the US blockade line averaged 6.7 million barrels per day over the past seven full days, combining AIS with daily satellite imagery including AIS-offline tankers — a datapoint sitting between Kpler's low transit counts and traders' ~7–8M bpd estimates.
